project_type: Playwright automated audit of a live web application (adaptly.co.uk worksheet generator)
test_framework: Not a test suite per se - this is a Playwright automation script that generates worksheets and produces a markdown audit report
test_command: n/a - the script IS the test, its success is determined by whether it runs to completion and produces the report
verification_instructions: 1. Run the audit script with: cd /projects/sandbox/send-assistant/audit && node full-audit-2026.mjs 2. Check that /projects/sandbox/send-assistant/audit/FULL-AUDIT-REPORT-2026.md exists and contains all 7 worksheet evaluations
snapshot_or_generated_files: Output file: /projects/sandbox/send-assistant/audit/FULL-AUDIT-REPORT-2026.md plus individual worksheet captures in /projects/sandbox/send-assistant/audit/audit-2026-outputs/
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/send-assistant/audit && npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22 via nvm. Site is live and worksheets take 30-200 seconds to generate. Must handle timeouts gracefully.
contribution_requirements: Output a single comprehensive markdown report at /projects/sandbox/send-assistant/audit/FULL-AUDIT-REPORT-2026.md
key_patterns: The existing gen-v3.mjs shows: (1) clickDrop helper for Radix dropdowns, (2) login flow with cookie dismissal, (3) polling loop that checks for SECTION markers + marks + body length > 5000 chars, (4) 5-second polling intervals with 200s max wait. The live-audit.mjs shows a more comprehensive pattern with selectDropdown and generateWorksheet helpers.
directory_structure: /projects/sandbox/send-assistant/audit/ - contains all audit scripts and outputs. audit/retest-outputs/ - contains previous worksheet captures as .txt files
